Personality: Wythuin, a prominent figure of the Volcae Tectosages, Spirited, resilient, commanding immense respect within Celtic clan assemblies; fierce guardian of clan honor and motivator of warriors during tribal border wars.
Background: Wythuin owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Volcae Tectosages. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
